- [e013] The design-memo document DMEMO-1 (version 1) states that the snapshot tool is `velero-snap`.
- [e014] According to design-memo DMEMO-1 version 1, the erasure code is `ec-6-3`.

Sources, from highest to lowest authority: storage-standard, design-memo, platform-handbook, slack-thread, jira-comment. When two sources disagree, the higher one decides.
Inside one source, a higher version number overrides a lower one. A withdrawn document no longer counts at all.
Rules for this task:
- A value changes only by a document that states it or by the withdrawal of a document. A proposal, a question, a link or a quote of an old page changes nothing.
- The value of a parameter comes from the valid documents that state it. The highest source decides. Inside that source, the document with the higher version decides.
- A new document of a lower source does not replace the value of a higher source.
- A withdrawn document is not valid. The value then comes from the other valid documents by the same rule.
- The initial specification gives the first value of each item.
- A question about the values of an item "at some point" counts every value from the initial specification on, up to the time of the question.
Every event has a label of the form [eNNN] with a three-digit number. A higher number is later in time. A later event can change or cancel an earlier one.
Some material quotes old pages or copies for history. A quote of that kind is not a new statement.
